create.title: Target-safe low-angular margin on the critical top block
create.statement_tex: Let I_Y subset [cY,CY] be consecutive with Y asymp sqrt(X) and R asymp sqrt(Y). Retain the exact active angular coefficient Omega_X^*(hq,h), all H_j floors, profile equality stars, the one-sided hard top, and the independent radial endpoint star. For every consecutive product window J subset I_Y of length at most R, including edge windows, the disjoint union {h<=H} dot-union {h>H,q<=Q} satisfies |sum_(n in J)^* A_(X;H,Q)(n)n^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xn))| <<_epsilon X^epsilon(H+Q)Y^(-1/2). Hence the exact moving-window identity gives |S_(Y;H,Q)|<<_epsilon X^epsilon(H+Q), so polylogarithmic H+Q is target-safe. The proof uses actual sampled BV, one-signed fixed-leg curvature ell^2/R for ell<=sqrt(R), and the trivial complementary length above sqrt(R). Active support further forces q>=4h, q>=2sqrt(n), and h<=sqrt(n)/2, so a polylogarithmic low-q margin is empty. After H=(log(2X))^B, the unresolved core is (log(2X))^B<h<=sqrt(n)/2 and q=n/h>=2sqrt(n). This is a physical radial lemma only and supplies no alpha transfer.
create.next_action: Use this lemma to delete only the polylogarithmic low-h margin. Attack the remaining intermediate-h, large-q core without summing fixed-leg absolute bounds.

update.next_action: On Y asymp sqrt(X), remove h<=(log(2X))^B using the proved low-leg lemma, then prove a signed window or Fejer bound for (log(2X))^B<h<=sqrt(n)/2 and q=n/h>=2sqrt(n), retaining chi_4, floors, profiles, and stars.
Apply Fejer only to the residual intermediate-h, large-q top-block core after deleting the target-safe low-h margin.

First solve the residual physical intermediate-h, large-q top-block core. Then separately prove common-antecedent connector and outside-height transfer; do not infer alpha closure from the physical low-margin theorem.

reject.reason: At perfect fourth powers actual admissible top-product examples have integral or half-integral first derivative. The proved theorem uses one-signed second derivative, not a derivative gap.
Each fixed leg costs Y^(-1/2), but polynomially many intermediate h legs remain; summing the lawful estimates recovers the Y^(1/4)-scale loss.
The finite mask connectors, signed Plemelj order, and outside-height limits are separate common-antecedent obligations not supplied by the physical radial estimate.

no_change.reason: The intermediate-h, large-q physical core and alpha transfer remain open.
The low-margin theorem alone proves no new discrepancy exponent.

round_assessment.reason: Round 55 rigorously removes every polylogarithmic low-h margin from the critical top block using actual-profile sampled BV and fixed-leg curvature, and sharpens the survivor by the cone q>=2sqrt(n). The polynomial intermediate-h core remains open, so no new exponent is claimed.
